fileheader.author: MMP project — non-production check-case model
fileheader.description:
NESC atmospheric check-case 3 body (damped). Homogeneous rectangular solid, 8 x 4 x 2.25 in on the body x/y/z axes. Mass and inertia are the published values (NASA/TM-2015-218675 Vol. II, appendix Table 4, about the CM, products of inertia zero).
No external aircraft file is used; the values are transcribed from public reference material with the source stated. That is not the same as "no third-party data" -- mass, inertia and coefficients all come from the published report.
IMPORTANT: the case OVERRIDES the base brick table. Table 5 lists CD 0.01, but atmospheric case 3 is titled "Dragless Brick with Aerodynamic Damping" and sets CD = 0.0. Only the damping derivatives are active:
CL = CD = CY = Cl = Cm = Cn = 0 Clp = Cmq = Cnr = -1.0, Clr = Cnp = 0
Drag would change the fall speed, hence dynamic pressure, hence the damping moments -- so getting this wrong contaminates the attitude result, not just the trajectory.
Check-case 3 is NOT a "no aerodynamics" case -- the damping derivatives are explicitly used, so rotational kinetic energy and angular momentum are no longer conserved and the acc02 invariants do not apply here.
